text:
Priya (Product): FYI — NovaBank just went into pilot and they have a tight set of compliance asks: FIPS 140-2 HSM-backed BYOK, immutable audit logs retained 7 years for EU/UK, plus SOC2 Type II evidence by end of Q3. Can we sketch a minimal launch checklist and call out hard blockers?

Oliver (Eng): thanks — rough blockers I see: HSM integration path (managed KMS vs on-prem HSM), immutable append-only storage for audit stream, and indexability for search without exposing PII.

Sam (Security): Confirming FIPS need. Also need attestation docs + key handling SOPs. If we use cloud HSM, NovaBank wants customer-controlled keys (BYOK) with HSM-sealed import.

Maya (AE): NovaBank is offering to sign an enterprise contract if we hit these. They can accept staged delivery: 1) BYOK with HSM import, 2) extended retention + legal-hold UI, 3) SOC2 evidence package. Sequence matters to close. :money_with_wings:

Jenna (Legal): We need to map contract language for key custody and export controls. Also clarify jurisdictional egress — EU/UK retention mandates mean we must guarantee data residency or demonstrate lawful transfer.

Anika (Console UX): Will need a simple toggle for "Legal Hold / Immutable Export" per tenant and an admin view for retention SLA. Mocking up a low-fidelity flow this week.

Oliver (Eng): Implementation proposal:
```
1) Integrate with customer KMS import API (HSM-wrapped key material) — 3 sprint effort.
2) Audit log pipeline: write-ahead append-only bucket (immutable lifecycle + retention policy) + signed manifests for tamper-evidence — 2 sprints.
3) Search layer: maintain separate index (redacted) for queryability; raw logs only downloadable via controlled export — 2 sprints.
```

Sam (Security): Also propose a short-term mitigation: for pilot, we can offer VPC-only ingestion + locked S3 bucket with Object Lock governance (WORM) while we complete HSM import flow. That buys time.

Priya (Product): Good. Need prioritization guidance: what must land before we present pilot to NovaBank vs what can be delivered post-contract? Suggest Must-Have = HSM BYOK import + immutable store + legal-hold export path. Nice-to-have = UI polish and SOC2 evidence pack automation.

Maya (AE): NovaBank will accept a staged SOW if Must-Have items are contractually guaranteed on a timeline (we can commit 6–8 weeks for the BYOK+WORM flow). They want a rollback/fallback plan too.

Jenna (Legal): I'll draft SOW language for staged delivery and acceptance criteria. Also need customer acceptance tests for evidence retrieval.

Oliver (Eng): Quick risks: cost of long-term retention (7 years) on hot storage, query performance degradation, support burden for KMS escrow processes. We should model costs per TB-month and propose cold-tier snapshotting after 90 days with verifiable hashes.

Priya (Product): Action items:
- Oliver: cost + infra design doc for HSM BYOK + immutable audit store (due EOD Thu).
- Sam: list of required security attestations and interim mitigations (Object Lock recipe) (due Wed).
- Jenna: SOW + acceptance criteria draft (due Fri).
- Anika: console mock for legal-hold + retention settings (preview Tue).
- Maya: confirm NovaBank's timeline and get signoff on staged SOW (ongoing).

infra-bot: Deploy preview bucket for WORM test created: s3://pilot-novabank-worm-preview (expires in 14 days).

Maya (AE): I'll ping NovaBank legal to align on acceptance tests once Jenna has the SOW.

Sam (Security): One more note — if NovaBank insists on on-prem HSM, we need to scope an on-prem connector (additional 3–4 weeks). Requesting decision from customer ASAP.

Priya (Product): Thanks everyone. If you have questions or need to reprioritize, flag in this thread. I’ll synthesize into a short roadmap doc after the deliverables come in. :white_check_mark:
